correctness.rationale: Exact orthogonal decomposition gives the fixed-gap norm. Two independently derived strict scalar inequalities bound odd and even contributions by 3 and 5. The even proof controls all t>0 by exact degree-eight-starting Taylor series for t<=6 and a quadratic estimate for t>=6. Taylor limits prove optimal 9 without fixed-gap equality; standalone computations corroborate but do not establish this analytic argument.
